text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: node-scratch-usage > 95% on cluster-gpu-2 (auto-created incident)

maria_gonzalez: seeing lots of OOM + CUDA init errors in model-serving pods, some are CrashLoopBackOff. paging oncall @jen_oncall

jen_oncall: I'm on it. what's the customer impact right now?

maria_gonzalez: user-facing: ~15% of requests to /v1/generate for model/redwood-7b return 500s or time out. internal metrics show modelcache churn and heavy writeback.

kevin_tsai: grabbing logs, tailing modelcache:
```
kubectl -n inference logs modelcache-7b-2 -c modelcache --since=5m | tail -n 100
E 2024-06-10T14:03:12 modelcache worker: write failed: no space left on device
E 2024-06-10T14:03:13 modelcache: panic: failed to allocate kv-cache
```

jordan_h: also seeing kernel messages on node:
```
Jun 10 14:02:58 node-gpu-2 kernel: tmpfs: missing inode, writeback failed
Jun 10 14:03:05 node-gpu-2 kernel: invoked oom-killer: task modelserver invoked oom
```

sre_lead: looks like /scratch (tmpfs-backed) filled due to log backlog + model cache snapshots. any recent rollout that increases logging?

maria_gonzalez: there was an experimental debug dump feature enabled for redwood-7b yesterday, it writes frequent snapshots to /scratch. ops runbook suggests disabling debug dumps immediately.

jen_oncall: immediate mitigations: 1) scale down model replicas to reduce writes, 2) delete non-critical pods using scratch, 3) clear old snapshots from /scratch, 4) restart modelcache after space reclaimed. doing step 1 now.

kevin_tsai: scaled redwood-7b from 6 -> 2 replicas (deployment autoscale override). sending command:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment redwood-7b --replicas=2
```

ops-bot: Deployment redwood-7b scaled to 2 replicas by kevin_tsai :white_check_mark:

maria_gonzalez: listing largest files on affected node (ssh into node-gpu-2):
```
ssh gpu-admin@node-gpu-2
sudo du -sh /scratch/* | sort -h | tail -n 20
```
Found several 12GB snapshots: /scratch/debug/dump-2024-06-09-*.tar.gz

jen_oncall: deleting debug snapshots older than 24h now (safe). running:
```
sudo find /scratch/debug -type f -mtime +1 -name "dump-*.tar.gz" -delete
```

kevin_tsai: cleaned ~180GB, free space back to ~70%.

maria_gonzalez: modelcache still reporting errors but fewer. restarting modelcache pod on node-gpu-2 to flush state.

jordan_h: note: one modelserver pod was in CrashLoopBackOff due to CUDA init failure after OOM, we should drain and restart it.

sre_lead: I'm updating incident priority to P1 due to customer impact and ongoing errors. notifying support.

support-bot: Created ticket INC-2024-637 and linked to this thread. Notifying affected customers via status page.

maria_gonzalez: rolling restart of model-serving pods with graceful drain:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart statefulset/model-serving-7b
kubectl -n inference cordon node-gpu-2 && kubectl -n inference drain node-gpu-2 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

kevin_tsai: drain started. note that drain will evict pods using local scratch; expecting a short spike in latency while pods reschedule.

jen_oncall: handing off to kevin_tsai for mitigation and follow-through. I'm going offline for scheduled break but will monitor watch channel.

jen_oncall: @kevin_tsai you're oncall owner. :point_up:

kevin_tsai: taking it. will monitor for 30m then report back. immediate followups: patch deployment to disable debug-dump flag, create admission webhook to prevent large tmp writes, and update runbook.

maria_gonzalez: patch ready, disabling debug dumps across prod:
```
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/redwood-7b DEBUG_DUMP=false
```

ops-bot: env DEBUG_DUMP set to false for deployment/redwood-7b by maria_gonzalez :white_check_mark:

kevin_tsai: after restarts, 500s dropped to ~0.8% and latency normalized. modelcache memory stable. marking mitigation as successful for now. continuing to monitor 15m window.

sre_lead: action items (assign):
- kevin_tsai: implement admission control to limit /scratch writes (owner) :spiral_note_pad:
- maria_gonzalez: follow up with model team to remove debug-dump feature or gate it behind config (owner) :memo:
- jen_oncall: update runbook with tmpfs cleanup steps and thresholds (owner) :wrench:
- support-bot: notify customers with root-cause once confirmed (owner) :envelope:

kevin_tsai: creating PR to add ephemeral-storage requests/limits and to disable write-heavy debug feature by default.

jordan_h: quick note: consider switching snapshots from tmpfs -> persistent volume to avoid whole-node pressure.

maria_gonzalez: +1 on PV suggestion, we'll evaluate for next sprint.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2024-637 transitioned to "mitigated" by kevin_tsai :white_check_mark:

kevin_tsai: final status: mitigated, customers seeing normal service. leaving for postmortem and follow-up. updating incident ticket with timeline.

sre_lead: thanks team. we'll collect logs and open a postmortem doc. tagging incident for postmortem review next week. :thumbsup:

jen_oncall: back on short watch, good handoff. :ok_hand:

maria_gonzalez: closing thread for now, will add links to postmortem and PRs here when ready.

support-bot: status page update: "Service degradation for model/redwood-7b resolved. Root cause: tmpfs scratch overflow from debug snapshots, led to modelcache OOMs and container crashes. Fix: removed debug dumps, restarted affected pods, added scaling and configuration fixes."

kevin_tsai: last check: no new OOMs in 10m. marking last_message_ts = 1743214600
